name: BARMM local government directory
note: Sulu is excluded: the Supreme Court removed it from BARMM. PSA census totals that still count Sulu will therefore be larger than the totals here. Province land area is the province’s own published figure, never a sum of its municipalities — Philippine municipal areas are self-reported and overlap, so they do not add up to the province they sit in.

officials.note: Winners are the top vote-getters in the Certificate of Canvass for the unit that elects the office. Council seat counts follow the Local Government Code: 8 in a municipality, 10 in a component city.
